item.scanner:headline: Sells Banistmo to La Hipotecaria for $1.418B cash
item.description:
Sells Banistmo to La Hipotecaria for $1.418B cash

Finalized the sale of Banistmo S.A. to Banco La Hipotecaria S.A. for USD 1.418 billion in cash, completing the divestiture announced in December 2025. The transaction was paid with funds from La Hipotecaria and an international syndicated loan. The sale is part of a portfolio optimization strategy to focus on strategic markets.

item.title: 💧 Capital Return · Recap · VSTD
item.scanner:headline: Dual-class structure eliminated; all Class B converts to Class A
item.description:
Dual-class structure eliminated; all Class B converts to Class A

Announced that BS1 Fund converted its 1,760,000 Class B shares into Class A shares, reducing its voting power below 25% and triggering automatic conversion of all outstanding Class B shares into Class A shares. The conversion eliminates the dual-class structure, with Class B's 10 votes per share replaced by Class A's 1 vote per share. BS1 Fund no longer controls a majority of voting power.

About: Vestand Inc. together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates Japanese restaurants in California. Vestand Inc. was formerly known as Yoshiharu Global Co. and changed its name to Vestand Inc. in September 2025. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Brea, California.
